messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

知識庫未對 Automotive signaling test capabilities 做重要性排名；但直接連到 Automotive 的 R&S 能力集中在 CMX500 的 4G/5G NG eCall、hybrid eCall、PSAP simulation、IMS voice/data、fallback、handover、degraded radio conditions 與 eCall audio/MSD/GNSS 驗證 [12][16][19][51]。
### 直接連到 Automotive 的 R&S signaling test capabilities
| Automotive application | R&S capability | 重要測試內容 | 證據 |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G | R&S CMX500 搭配 R&S CMX-KA098 可用於 NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。[22] | 測試涵蓋 NG eCall voice and data transmission，並可模擬 PSAP。[12] | [12][22] |
| EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification | Rohde & Schwarz 與 Qualcomm Technologies 使用 R&S CMX500 驗證 Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF 的 NG eCall functionality 符合 EN 17240:2024。[9] | 驗證內容包含 implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。[12] | [9][12] |
| Hybrid eCall | R&S CMX500-based solution 搭配 CMX-KA09x 支援 EN 18052:2025 與 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance。[14] | Hybrid eCall 要求 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 可靠運作與 fallback。[15] | [14][15] |
| IP/IMS-based emergency call | 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。[16] | 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 fallback 到 classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。[16] | [16] |
| PSAP scenario testing | R&S CMX-KA098 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 17240:2024+A1:2026。[14] | R&S CMX-KA099 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025。[14] | [14] |
| VoNR / VoLTE / CS fallback | Hybrid eCall network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network conditions simulation and various network scenarios emulation。[19] | Manufacturers need to validate trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality。[16] | [16][19] |
| IMS eCall protocol behavior | NGeCall test topics include IMS eCall session establishment with automatic, manual and test eCall URNs。[56] | Test topics also include MSD transfer, MSD update, PSAP request, negative acknowledgement and missing acknowledgement scenarios。[56] | [56] |
| eCall service conditions | NGeCall test topics include valid SIM/USIM, forbidden PLMN, limited service condition and roaming scenario。[56] | Test topics include PSAP initiated callback, call clear-down and IVS initiated clear-down not allowed。[56] | [56] |
| Voice and audio path | NGeCall test topics include voice link established and audio interface verification。[56] | CMX-KA180 provides audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call and supports AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS。[5] | [5][56] |
| Speech quality | R&S CMX-KA181 adds POLQA for measuring perceived speech quality。[5] | R&S CMX-KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA measurements and end-to-end audio delay。[5] | [5] |
### R&S CMX500 signaling platform capabilities relevant as the test foundation
| Capability area | R&S capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Cellular network emulation | R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD。[1] | [1] |
| 5G/LTE signaling | R&S CMX500 provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and LTE signaling。[3] | [3] |
| LTE/NR signaling options | R&S CMX-KS500B/M/X provide LTE signaling basic, medium and expert。[7] | [7] |
| NR SA/NSA signaling | R&S CMX-KS600B/M/X provide NR signaling Rel. 15 and include 5G NR SA option 2, NSA option 3, DL 2x2/4x4 MIMO, one CC and UL 256QAM。[7] | [7] |
| Advanced NR signaling | R&S CMX-KS610B/M/X add UL 2x2 MIMO and carrier aggregation up to 9 CC。[7] | [7] |
| Rel. 16 features | R&S CMX-KS611B/M/X add SUL and Rel. 16 features。[7] | [7] |
| RedCap / eRedCap / NTN | R&S CMX-KS617B/M/X support NR Rel. 17 RedCap, R&S CMX-KS618B/KS618X support Rel. 18 eRedCap, and R&S CMX-KS627B/M/X through KS629B/X support NR NTN Rel. 17 to Rel. 19 extensions。[38] | [38] |
| Realistic radio conditions | R&S CMX500 supports fading propagation conditions。[1] | [1] |
| Fading and performance metrics | R&S CMX500 provides fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement。[3] | [3] |
| Application and IP testing | R&S CMX-KA100 provides internal IP services and IP connection to DUT test applications including DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput and Max Throughput Wizard。[5] | [5] |
| IP analysis | R&S CMX-KA150 provides an IP analysis tool to monitor and analyze DUT uplink and downlink IP traffic。[5] | [5] |
| Automation and protocol analysis | CMsquares supports RF tests, functional tests, advanced signaling tests and protocol tests。[8] | [8] |
| Scripting | R&S CMsequencer creates, configures and runs test scripts, XLAPI supports complex Python scripting, and SCPI supports simple standardized remote control。[8] | [8] |
### Automotive configuration items explicitly listed
| Scenario | Listed R&S configuration items | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G | CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX500, CMX-KS600B LTE/NR Signaling Enabler Rel.15 Basic Level, CMX-KA100, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA110 for IMS tests from EN17240:2024, CMX-KA401 for TS17240 In-Band Modem over IP tests, CMX-KA098 for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 and CMX-KF671B NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS as mandatory items。[63] | [63] |
| Hybrid eCall EN18052:2025 | Hybrid minimum configuration lists CMX-KS600B, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA401, CMX-KA094, CMX-KA098, CMX-KA099 and CMX-KF672B as mandatory CMX500-side software items。[62] | [62] |
| PCT NGeCall | CMX500 PCT NGeCall configuration lists CMX-B200A, CMX-B600B, CMX-KS600B, CMX-KS600M and CMX-KS600X as mandatory items。[64] | [64] |
### 限制
The passages do not provide full test case IDs, full pass/fail reports, measurement conditions, software versions or full certification scope for the cited eCall verifications [17][23][48][55].

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。

- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available，需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。

- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS callback abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 在既有 CMW500 來源中標示 Not available；CMX500 來源中 34.229-1 區段也可辨識 Not Available 標註。

### 直接連到 Automotive 的 R&S signaling test capabilities

| IP/IMS-based emergency call | 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。[16] | 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 fallback 到 classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。[16] | [16] |
| PSAP scenario testing | R&S CMX-KA098 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 17240:2024+A1:2026。[14] | R&S CMX-KA099 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025。[14] | [14] |

Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF › NG eCall / EN 17240:2024 verification
本來源中的驗證說法如下：

- Verification process employed [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 comprehensive testing solution for NG eCall including voice and data transmission。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 [[EN 18052]] 或 [[EN 17240]] 標準文本摘要。
- 來源未提供正式 certification report、certificate number、測試日期或完整 test matrix。

- 不可從新聞稿推論 [[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] 已涵蓋所有 possible hybrid eCall test cases。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試情境
來源明示或列出的 network scenarios 包含：

- [[VoNR]]。
- [[VoLTE]]。
- circuit-switched fallback。
- handovers。
- degraded radio conditions。
- real-world mobile network conditions simulation。
- various network scenarios emulation。

來源沒有提供各 scenario 的 test case IDs、channel model、radio profile 或 pass/fail criteria。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 EN 17240:2024 標準摘要、conformance test plan 或 certification report。
